patch.value: Refresh projections from mutation events with sparse work receipts

Acceptance: after initial admission, one update among 10000 items avoids a complete successful refresh scan; cursor gaps force a disclosed rebuild or refusal; incremental and full projections are equal. Deliver typed SDK and CLI, compact receipts and remedies, seeded state and concurrency tests, non-git public-corpus validation, and npm plus Bun CI release gates.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap rechecked against current CLI and sibling sources: SDK mutation-events owns cursors and history reads; graph snapshot impact compares complete graphs; syncNeo4j in src/index.ts still upserts every input node and relationship. pm-web consumes event pages for resume and history delivery, and pm-rust complete-projection receipts certify reads rather than update a persisted graph. This feature owns only derived projection state, sparse work receipts and sink reconciliation. No upstream or sibling changes planned.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implementation now uses lazy supported SDK package exports, certified complete admission, opaque mutation cursors, SDK point reads, anchor/stream continuity checks, owned checkpoint locking, finite/dense boundary validation, and exact recoverable receipt pages. Explicit rebuild is required after continuity or workspace-schema changes. Cached graph materialization and checkpoint encoding still visit cached rows; receipts separately disclose full source scans and SDK event-page source. Neo4j reconciliation uses a revision CAS inside one write transaction and a separate owned namespace. Seeded model and real-host regressions are being validated.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Evidence: seeded model seed 0x261027 passed 500 random sequences through real SDK reads and mutations. The 10000-item non-git case read one updated item with zero complete refresh item scans, evaluated 3 nodes and 2 edges, emitted 814 JSON bytes and equaled both certified full output and an explicit rebuild. Public main corpus at 4b5e7a1: 108 items, 203 nodes, 372 edges, 1138 admission events; caught-up reads/scans/events all zero, 538 JSON bytes, derived_index, 1108 ms admission plus catch-up. Source copy was read-only, authoritative bytes unchanged. Public data exposed omitted legacy dependency metadata; producer JSON normalization and a regression now cover it. Behavioral revert proof: replacing only refreshEventProjection catch-up admission decision with unconditional rebuild makes the sparse regression fail (fullScans 1 versus required 0); implementation restored. All 12 competing-refresher transition boundaries pass, and interrupted-sink retry checks current target revisions.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Final concurrency review found a driver retry detail: a Neo4j transaction callback may be invoked more than once, so its outcome is reset inside every attempt. The new regression repeats the transaction callback, injects a competing revision, and verifies SINK_CONFLICT rather than a stale success. Targeted Neo4j adapter regression passes. No source behavior or thresholds changed.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Re-review round 1 resumed. Rules: storage presence must be independent of decoded payload values, and a rebuild must reset every cursor-derived state field as one generation. Both reported blockers are valid. The package-wide audit covers SDK readers/writers, CLI JSON and TOON, packed npm/Bun hosts and non-git trackers. Main is merged before remediation; no prior completed implementation or validation will be repeated without a new change requiring it.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Round 1 class audit: (1) Presence is an out-of-band storage fact, never a decoded JSON value or truthiness decision. readState now returns tagged missing/invalid/present outcomes; only ENOENT permits admission. SDK readEventProjection intentionally retains its nullable read-only contract, while receipt reads refuse invalid payloads. The project manifest and snapshot readers also collapse invalid inputs only on read-only/refusal paths; explicit export output writers do not infer ownership from decoded content. No second writer with this defect was found. (2) Cursor, anchor and subject versions form one event generation. eventGeneration starts all three fresh on rebuild while retaining the previous target revision solely for CAS lineage and old graph rows solely for reconciliation. All fallback and prior-state references, SDK/CLI transports and both graph sinks were checked. No additional non-blocking finding was supplied or found in the class audit.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Adversarial evidence: 116 foreign payload cases cover every JSON root type, falsey values, malformed inputs and whitespace/CRLF, with incremental and rebuild attempts, offline and sink targets, plus byte preservation. Empty, workspace-only, item-only and mixed replacement streams rebuild and resume incrementally through real SDK reads; an unchanged pre-fix v1 checkpoint remains readable/exportable. Real non-git CLI JSON/TOON tests passed, including receipt and Neo4j-flag refusal paths. Revert proofs: reverting only readState to classify decoded null as missing makes the storage-presence test fail (admission instead of FOREIGN_STATE); restoring only the old anchor fallback in refreshEventProjection makes the generation test fail with SOURCE_INCOMPLETE on an empty stream. Both processes exited 1, and the fixes were restored. Test and coverage runners now explicitly cap concurrency at two, with thresholds unchanged.

value.author: codex-agent

Typecheck, test typecheck, lint, zero-duplication, build and changelog checks pass. A local full npm gate was started, then intentionally interrupted to honor the original saturated-host instruction to use CI for full-gate evidence; it is not counted as passing. Its test processes have exited. The explicit two-worker limits will apply to both full CI release gates without changing thresholds.
